senses.gloss: m. (dial. for צַוָּאר; סָוַר = צָבַר; v. Maim. to Ohol. III, 7 ed. Dehr.) a pile of joists, frame. Ohol. III, 7 ס׳ של קורות (ed. Dehr. צוואר, in comment. צַוָּור, Var. צֶבֶר); Succ. 20ᵇ (Ms. M. סוואר); Y. Sabb. IV, 7ᵃ top צבר.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 31b:2">Bets. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מבקעין עצים לא מן הס׳ וכ׳</he> we must not chop (on the Holy Day, for immediate use) wood from a pile of joists (intended for building purposes), v. <cite ref="M00475"><he>מוּכָן</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 4</cite> <he>ס׳ של נחתומין הפרוס וכ׳</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:2">Kel. XV, 2</cite> <cite ref="O01551"><he>סרוד</he></cite>) the baker’s frame when it is plain (without rims) is unclean, because dough is cut and carried to the stove on it.—V. <cite ref="O00411"><he>סָוַר</he></cite>.
